reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
ٱلَّذِى is the object seen or identified by أَرَءَيْتَ.
بِٱلدِّينِ supplies the governed complement of يُكَذِّبُ through the prefixed بِـ.
ٱلَّذِى is the predicate identifying ذَٰلِكَ.
ٱلْيَتِيمَ is the accusative object pushed away by يَدُعُّ.
طَعَامِ is governed by عَلَىٰ as the target complement of يَحُضُّ.
ٱلْمِسْكِينِ is the genitive second term of the construct طَعَامِ.
لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ is governed by prefixed لِـ and relates the doom وَيْلٌ to the worshippers.
لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ functions as the predicate phrase for وَيْلٌ.
صَلَاتِهِمْ is governed by عَن as the matter from which سَاهُونَ are heedless.
سَاهُونَ is the predicate of هُمْ in the nominal clause.
يُرَآءُونَ is the predicate of هُمْ in the relative description.
ٱلْمَاعُونَ is the accusative thing withheld by يَمْنَعُونَ.
